दक्षिणरेलवे/SOUTHERN RAILWAY 

  चने्नैमडंल/CHENNAI DIVISION 

    No. PUB/MAS/2023/12/06                                   Date: 05.12.2023 

 

प्रसेक्षवज्ञक्षि /PRESS RELEASE 

RESTORATION OF SUBURBAN TRAIN SERVICES IN  
ALL SECTIONS OF CHENNAI DIVISION 

  

The Suburban train services have been resumed at 14:00 hrs of 
05.12.2023 in the section as follows: 

1. Chennai Egmore – Tambaram – Chengalpattu @ 30 minutes frequency. 
2. Chennai Beach – Tiruvallur – Arakkonam (via Perambur) @ 30 minutes 
frequency. 

In addition, train services have been resumed in MRTS section between 
Velachery and Chintadripet by 15:00 hrs on 05.12.2023 @ 30 minutes 
frequency. 

Similar pattern will be followed on 06.12.2023 (Wednesday) until 
further advice. 

Sd/-
